name: Tornville Haunt
description: The old haunt at the forest's edge.

name: Gallows Copse
description: A restless swarm.

name: Blackthorn Hollow
description: Thick thorns hide heavy beasts.

name: The Burnt Hamlet
description: Blackened beams and narrow lanes between fallen houses.

name: Wychwood Circle
description: The old stones hum. The packs come in great surges.

name: Forgotten Barrow
description: Something stirs beneath the mound.

name: Charcoal Burner's Camp
description: Smoke hangs low over the old kilns.

name: Stag's Crossing
description: Where the old ford cuts through the forest.

name: Briar Chapel
description: Thorns have swallowed the old chapel.

name: The Ember Road
description: A raised road between pits that still smoulder.

name: Blackbark Orchard
description: Fire-blackened fruit trees, still standing.

name: Mossbound Cairn
description: Moss-covered stones mark an ancient grave.

name: The Ashen Glade
description: Nothing grows here since the fire.

name: Bone Orchard
description: Pale branches, and paler things among the roots.

name: The Weeping Stones
description: The standing stones are always wet, though it never rains.

name: Hollow of Bells
description: Somewhere below, a bell tolls. The packs answer.

name: The Heartwood
description: The heart of Broceliande, and the rot at its centre.

name: Tallow Fen
description: Pale candles of fat float on the water. Someone still lights them.

name: The Lantern Fen
description: Lights drift over the reeds. Follow them and you won't come back.

name: The Rotting Ford
description: The old ford has gone soft. Things wade across it that shouldn't.

name: Bonewhite Willows
description: The willows have gone white as bone, and still they weep.

name: The Corpse Reedbeds
description: The reeds grow thick here. Something keeps them fed.

name: The Drowned Gallows
description: The gallows stand knee-deep in water. The hanged did not stay hanged.

name: The Leechwater Pools
description: Warm, still water. Don't put your hand in.

name: Wormwood Hollow
description: Bitter herbs choke the hollow, and the dead seem to like it.

name: The Sallow Mere
description: A wide grey lake that never quite reflects the sky.

name: The Drowned Tannery
description: The vats overflowed long ago. The stink never left.

name: The Sunken Ossuary
description: The bone-house slid into the bog. Its tenants climbed back out.

name: The Widow's Mire
description: She walked in looking for him. Neither came out.

name: The Plague Carts
description: Abandoned carts, still loaded. Nobody came back to bury them.

name: The Weeping Sluice
description: The sluice gates leak a steady trickle, day and night.

name: Carrion Orchard
description: The fruit rots on the branch, and the crows won't touch it.

name: The Drowned Bell Tower
description: The tower sank to its belfry. On still nights the bell still rings.

name: The Blackwater Shrine
description: An altar to something older than the saints, half under black water.

name: Bog King's Rest
description: Where the Causeway ends, the peat rises into a throne.
